meta.description: Illustrative EU default, not market data: a sleeved PPA: the pay-as-produced price plus a utility's sleeving fee on the delivered MWh. Every value sits inside a cited public range (see notes); replace it with your own offer.
notes: not market data: a starting point to replace with your own offer or an organisation pack

range:price=35..75 EUR/MWh|dena PPA-Marktanalyse 2025, p. 7: indicative 10-year as-produced PPA prices in Germany, solar 35-45 to offshore wind 65-75|https://www.dena.de/fileadmin/dena/Publikationen/PDFs/2026/PPA_Marktanalyse_2025.pdf|2026
range:sleeving_fee_eur_per_mwh=1..5 GBP/MWh|Clearsight Energy glossary, Sleeved PPA: typical sleeve fees GBP 1 to 5 per MWh|https://www.clearsightenergy.com/glossary/sleeved-ppa/|2026

range:tenor_years=5..20 years|EIB Advisory, commercial PPA study: a cPPA is a long-term contract 'e.g. of 5-20 years'|https://advisory.eib.org/files/publications/attachments/developing-potential-financial-instruments-and-advisory-solutions-to-stimulate-more-investment-in-renewable-energy-generation-by-means-of-commercial-power-purchase-agreements.pdf|2023
fx:sleeving_fee_eur_per_mwh: the cited range is in GBP; 3 EUR/MWh lies inside it at any rate from 0.34 to 1.66 GBP per EUR
sleeving_party: name the utility that sleeves the power when you fill the template
placeholders:seller,buyer,asset_ids hold a fill-in marker; the server refuses to save or settle the contract until each is replaced
changes_dispatch:false (settled after the solve; never shapes the dispatch)
